name: matchstyle
description: Style regex-matched text with custom fonts, sizes, weights, and colors.

matchStyle.enabled.markdownDescription: Style matched text while other text keeps its editor styling. Font family and size use an experimental CSS decoration workaround because VS Code has no public per-range font API.

matchStyle.rules.description: Regex rules with text styling. Earlier rules take priority; overlapping matches from later rules are skipped.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression without / delimiters. Escape backslashes in JSON. The full match is styled; empty matches are ignored.

flags.description: Optional regex flags: i (ignore case), m (multiline), s (dot matches newlines), u (Unicode). Defaults to u. Global matching (g) is always enabled.

fontFamily.description: Installed font family or comma-separated font stack. Omit to keep the editor font.

fontSize.description: Font size in pixels. Set editor.lineHeight high enough for the larger font.

fontWeight.description: Font weight, independent of the syntax theme.

color.description: Text color as a CSS hex value, such as #FFD60A. Omit to keep the syntax theme color.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run bundle:prod
